spec.name: Trend v18
spec.notes: Searched 244 variants of this signal; the figure quoted is the best of them and should be read with that in mind. The family has a long record as a premium.

claim.text: Research-period backtest: Sharpe 1.7, annual return 7%, maximum drawdown 12%.

exhibits.summary: The log holds 245 distinct specs; the best of 245 under no edge is expected to reach a Sharpe of 0.57, so the claimed 1.70 becomes 1.13 and the probability that the true Sharpe is above zero is 100%.
The real signal's gross Sharpe of 1.78 beats 100% of 200 shuffled signals (shuffled mean 0.01, 95th percentile 0.62).
On the sealed period, traded as live (strict data, 10 bps, at least one bar of lag), the Sharpe ratio is 3.90 against 1.67 in research, a gap of -2.23.
The scan (a heuristic) found no phrase addressed to reviewers or giving instructions in 2 text sources.
On the full universe the Sharpe ratio is 1.67 against 1.67 as submitted; the strategy never saw 0 delisted assets.

verdict.opinion: The strategy's claimed Sharpe ratio of 1.7 is significantly inflated. EX-1 shows that the best of 245 trials is expected to have a Sharpe of 0.57, but the claimed Sharpe is 1.7, which is inflated by 1.13. This indicates selection bias, as the best-performing variant was selected without proper validation. Therefore, paper trading is recommended.
